preconditions.description: The lengths of strings A and B are within the specified bounds.
The lengths of the input strings A and B match the given integers n and m.

preconditions.expression: all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz' for c in A) and all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz' for c in B)
preconditions.description: Both strings A and B consist only of lowercase Latin letters.

postconditions.expression: stdout == str(max(4 * len(lcs) - len(C) - len(D) for C in substrings(A) for D in substrings(B) for lcs in [longest_common_subsequence(C, D)]))
postconditions.description: The output is the maximal similarity score S(C, D) = 4 * LCS(C, D) - |C| - |D| over all pairs of substrings (C, D) where C is a substring of A and D is a substring of B.
